operations.credit_rule_for_next_section: Only concepts with state USABLE may be assumed in S05. PARTIAL, MENTION_ONLY, MISCONCEPTION_RISK and MISSING receive no automatic prerequisite credit.

effective_campaign_state.note_on_counts: Running local counts only. Mandatory global passes may merge recurring root causes, reject false positives or change severity when later dependency evidence is available.

S05_entry_watchlist: S05 is the first roadmap section allowed to assume and teach functions, return, parameters and gradual type hints. Prior def/return appearances remain MENTION_ONLY and S05 must teach them from first principles.
S04's for loop and sentinel concepts are USABLE, but range/enumerate/zip/while/comprehension/state trace/off-by-one are not fully creditable due local defects.
Lists/tuples/dicts/sets/indexing/unpacking remain MENTION_ONLY until S06. S05 examples must not treat those structures as mastered inputs merely because S02-S04 used them.
Invariant remains MISCONCEPTION_RISK until repaired; S05 contracts/preconditions/postconditions must not silently inherit the false 'cannot be broken' model.
O(n) remains MISCONCEPTION_RISK because S04 equated linear design with one pass; S05 should not assume a correct complexity model.
CP-N1-A/CASO identifiers remain a persistent widow-term family unless first-use expansion is repaired globally.
